notes.title: Update Notes 2020.8.13
notes.content:
Hi,

In the last week we made several changes to the game including:

1. Making dodge a lot easier, now you can basically use dodge to cancel your current move. This is not our original design but since a lot of our players request this so strongly we had no choice.
2. Fixed several displaying bug for the princess including crack on the back and a rendering bug for "old school suite"
3. Performance optimization. The loading speed is increased.

Thank you for playing light tracer 2.

notes.title: Update Note 2020.8.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791046/c2b58d4db3db6835f53136c21ef8e56c50da2e51.png[/img]
Hi, during last week, we released some updates. Our main focus is to improve the quality of experience, and adjust some mechanics to help our players to enjoy the game better.

The main changes include:
1. Now unlocking challenges will only cost very few credits;
2. Some missing sound effects in cutscenes are added;
3. More achievements are added and now you are able to track your progress in game. The game has different endings so make sure you don't miss them!

We may also try to ask you to consider enable "Easy Mode" in game if you find the battle is too difficult (which is what the original design of Light Tracer 2). To enable it, you need to get defeat for 3 times in 5 minutes, and then there will be a message coming up.
We hope every player can enjoy the journey of Light Tracer 2.

notes.title: DOUYU will simultaneously open a special live event
notes.content:
The Steam Summer Festival is coming and we would like to thank you all for taking part in our Beta tests.

During the Steam Summer Games Festival (June 17-June 22), [i]DOUYU[/i] will simultaneously open a special live event, more than 30 games that participate in this online game display. Our game [i]Light Tracer 2[/i] is also in it!
During the event, you can see three independent game players participate in the trial play, and they will also send rich prizes during the live broadcast. Looking forward to your participation!

notes.title: Demo is Coming!!
notes.content:
Hi players! Hope you guys can check out our demo and give some feedback! 

The demo will roughly feature part of the game on this [i]Steam Festival 6/16~6/22[/i]. 

We would love to get some feedback from our players for the full game, which we're still polishing so please let us know thru the community page, our email [socialcomms@voiddimensions.cc], via our twitter [@LightTracer2], or join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/578220729682755603]discord[/url].
